req.title: Update only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to update a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to update it. This is a classic authorization check, where we need to ensure that unauthorized users receive a 403 Forbidden response. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_post_by_author
preconditions: User is logged in as the author of the post
actions: Attempt to update the post with valid data
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login as author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Original Title', 'body': 'Original Body'})

# Update the post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_by_non_author
preconditions: User is logged in as a non-author
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login as author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Original Title', 'body': 'Original Body'})

# Logout author
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Register and login as non-author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Attempt to update the post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Malicious Update', 'body': 'Malicious Body'})
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_update_post_boundary_case
preconditions: User is logged in as the author of the post
actions: Attempt to update the post with minimal valid data
